method: Test-only read/write/send-error rendezvous blocks the caller-thread native return while a worker cancels a public token or waits for the absolute deadline. Both rendezvous entry and non-timeout release are asserted. Worker never accesses stream state.
limitations: Controlled loopback interleavings only; no exhaustive scheduler, TLS-version, readiness/error, shutdown/cancel or malformed-post-handshake matrix
Control checks define observation points; cancellation and Future publication are not an atomic cross-thread transaction
Only test fixtures block native returns; product I/O remains nonblocking and caller-driven
TLS-accepted bytes are not remote acknowledgements; no new replay guarantee
macOS/Linux bridge/harness use ASan/UBSan; upstream OpenSSL libraries are not claimed sanitized; Windows is unsanitized
macOS x86_64, mobile, system trust, portable public SDK/release delivery and other roadmap gates remain open
